title: Hierarchical Canonical Path Mutex
problem: Production no_stacking uses string equality and misses parent/child directory collisions, Windows case differences, and dot segments.
evidence: Verified in WS5 (EXP-WS5-CONCURR-001). Mutants MUT-06 and MUT-07 killed.
proposed_change_boundary: Replace exact string match with HierarchicalPathMutex canonical prefix tree.
rollback: Revert to exact string matching via configuration toggle.
independent_verifier: Filesystem watcher verifying zero overlapping writer leases.
known_risks: Sub-directory workers will be blocked if root directory lock is held.
stop_condition: Acquisition failure on non-overlapping independent workspaces.
